directive.quote: NO rewrites from scratch. Originals move wholesale (byte for byte); a rewrite that lost capability is replaced by the most complete original.

preserve: every export, prop, option and rule the files hold stays as the original wrote it
allowed_deltas: none: the files move byte for byte; imports keep the original's own form until a build maps it
banned_substitutions: a rewritten copy of any of these parts
a second copy kept in the web shell
